hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: The UI shell is polished — clean card, intentional blue/amber palette, clear typographic hierarchy in the controls — but the circle-pack visualization overflows the viewport (cropped at bottom), edge-bundle lines tangle into an unreadable dark mass, and node labels are too small to read, keeping the actual data layer from earning the craft invested in the chrome.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Topology/hierarchy encoding is structurally honest — scaleSqrt used correctly for force node radii, data-driven extents, key functions on data joins — but multiple layout modes use hardcoded fixed radii (radialPathStr at r=5.2) regardless of node weight, a minor magnitude-encoding inconsistency.
flags: Update Storm: force simulation tick calls redrawLinks() on all 300 paths every tick without RAF coalescing

Update Storm: tension slider .on('input') guard checks for '.transitioning' class that is never added anywhere, making the throttle a no-op — redrawLinks() fires on every slider mousemove unconditionally

Mid-Flight Snap: no explicit .interrupt() call before starting new svg.transition(); relies on implicit D3 interruption — force-layout shape tween (flubber, 750ms) has no interrupt cleanup for current_x/current_y
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Force-tick storms and a dead-code throttle guard on the tension slider are the primary robustness failures; transition interruption is partially handled by D3 implicitly but lacks explicit .interrupt() discipline.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle-pack clustering gives readable group structure (~10 Tableau colors, 200 nodes) but 300 random cross-group edge bundles produce a dense spaghetti tangle at the center that overwhelms the hierarchy signal; full animation load (1500ms flubber morph of all nodes+edges across 8 layout modes) cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
